svg.title: Chat — WebSocket connect, catch-up and reconnect with backoff (sequence)

g.text: Chat — WebSocket connect, catch-up and reconnect with backoff (sequence)
Subscribe BEFORE reading the DB so nothing
published in between is lost; client de-dupes by seq.
SELECT ready messages WHERE seq > since ORDER BY seq LIMIT 200
REST fetch after_seq=lastSeq → fill gap, then append
on disconnect ZREM "{user}:{conn}" → presence.update if user's last conn
Crash safety: a sweeper task in every api process runs every 30 s:
presence.update for users that dropped to zero connections.
also reconnect immediately on window "online" event
and app-level ping every 25 s (server closes idle at 60 s)
